hooks: Did you know Lou Sanders was once an Ofcom complaints handler?
Lou Sanders won Taskmaster in 2019 and Dancing on Ice in 2024.
Comedian Lou Sanders moved out of her home at just 15.
sources: ‘We tried to levitate the Pentagon’: the almost unbelievable life of Ed Sanders, trickster god of the US counterculture

topics.what_is_new: Minior made its debut in Pokémon Go on 19 October 2026 to coincide with the Orionids meteor shower.
hooks: Minior has finally fallen into Pokémon Go during real world meteor showers!
You can earn one million Stardust during the new Minior Shower event!
Catch the Green Core Minior before the Orionids shower ends this Saturday!

verified.claim: Minior has two different forms in Pokémon Go known as Meteor and Core.

evidence.1: Minior has two forms: Meteor and Core.
evidence.2: Minior also has two forms to use in battle.

verified.claim: Minior will only be available in Pokémon Go during real world meteor showers.

evidence.1: this Pokémon will only be available during specific Minior Showers which match up with real world meteor showers.
evidence.2: it'll only be available during real-life meteor showers.

verified.claim: The Orionids Minior Shower takes place from 19 October to 24 October.

evidence.1: Orionids Shower (Green Minior) Ends: Saturday 24th October at 11:59pm (local time)
evidence.2: The next Minior Shower in Pokémon Go is from Oct. 19-24.

verified.claim: Minior appears more frequently in the wild between 5pm and 9pm local time during these events.

evidence.1: Minior has increased spawn rates between 5pm to 9pm (local time) on every day during each meteor shower.
evidence.2: During these meteor shower events, you'll be able to find Minior more often from 5-9 p.m. in your local time on the listed days.

verified.claim: Minior changes from Meteor Form to Core Form when its HP drops below 50 percent.

evidence.1: Minior will remain in its Meteor form until its HP drops beneath 50% when it's coloured Core will be exposed.
evidence.2: After losing 50% of its HP, the shell will break off and you'll be able to see its core.

verified.claim: Minior can currently only change forms during Team Rocket battles and the Go Battle League.

evidence.1: Upon its initial release, Minior can only change forms when battling Team Rocket, including the leaders, and in the Go Battle League.
evidence.2: As of writing this, Minior will only be able to change forms in PvP, against Team Go Rocket members, and against team leaders.

verified.claim: Shiny Minior is not yet available in Pokémon Go.

evidence.1: No, shiny Minior is not in Pokémon Go.
evidence.2: Minior is not available shiny yet.

one_source.claim: The Gemininds shower is the only event where two different Minior colours will be released.

evidence.1: The exception to this is the Gemininds shower where two colours will be released - one for the Northern hemisphere and for the Southern.

one_source.claim: Players can earn 1,000,000 Stardust by completing a bonus Timed Research quest.
The Leonids Minior Shower is scheduled to occur from 14 November to 19 November.

evidence.2: Leonids: Nov. 14-19

one_source.claim: Shooting stars will appear in the game to indicate when the Minior spawn bonus is active.

evidence.1: There will even be shooting stars in-game, so you know exactly when this bonus is active!
